title: Glowing tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="34" ry="6" fill="#2a3a5e" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Tent main body -->
  <polygon points="50,20 20,78 80,78" fill="#e8a33d"/>
  
  <!-- Tent front opening (glowing interior) -->
  <polygon points="50,28 30,78 70,78" fill="#ffe87a"/>
  
  <!-- Glow rays from opening -->
  <polygon points="50,28 35,78 40,78 50,34" fill="#fff5b0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <polygon points="50,28 60,78 65,78 50,34" fill="#fff5b0" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Tent side panels (darker shade) -->
  <polygon points="50,20 20,78 42,78 50,30" fill="#c47e28"/>
  <polygon points="50,20 80,78 58,78 50,30" fill="#d49038"/>
  
  <!-- Tent pole (center ridge) -->
  <line x1="50" y1="18" x2="50" y2="78" stroke="#f5c05e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Tent pole top knob -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="3" fill="#ffdd77"/>
  
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="28" ry="22" fill="#ffe87a" opacity="0.15"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="20" ry="15" fill="#ffe87a" opacity="0.1"/>
  
  <!-- Tent bottom edge -->
  <line x1="20" y1="78" x2="80" y2="78" stroke="#b06820" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Small star/sparkle above tent -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#aaccee"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="24" r="1.2" fill="#aaccee"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="15" r="1" fill="#88aadd"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="12" r="1.3" fill="#88aadd"/>
  
  <!-- Glow sparkles inside opening -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="60" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="68" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
